prompts.title: 超现实混合媒体插画提示
prompts.description: 为 Nano Banana Pro 创建超逼真 8k 混合媒体插画的详细提示（使用上传图片作为参考）。插画风格结合了照片写实主义与抽象的都市速写元素，并运用了墨迹飞溅、建筑轮廓以及醒目的红色点缀。
prompts.content: A hyper-realistic 8k mixed-media illustration of a person in a medium shot [Use the uploaded image as reference], rendered with cinematic lighting and highly detailed textures, set against an abstract, urban-sketch style background. The character, with uploaded face as reference, features voluminous dark hair styled upwards and a well-groomed beard, wearing red-framed wayfarer-style sunglasses with dark, reflective lenses. They are dressed in a vibrant, deep red ribbed crew-neck sweater, with arms crossed over the chest, looking slightly to the right. The background is composed of fragmented, stylized cityscapes, architectural outlines, scribbles, and ink splatters in shades of grey, black, and white, with striking red accents and splashes that echo the sweater's color. prompts.title: 奇幻水彩城市插画提示词
prompts.description: 为 Nano Banana Pro 生成的详细提示，用于创作一幅奇幻手绘水彩插画：一座密集的山坡城市蔓延至港口，强调流畅的颜料晕染、精致的线条和经典的童话书美学。
prompts.content:
Scene:
A dense hillside city spreads downward toward a wide river harbor packed with cargo ships, ferries, and floating markets. Countless tightly stacked buildings climb the slopes, their rooftops crowded with satellite dishes, water tanks, and hanging laundry. Elevated pedestrian walkways cross between structures while narrow alleys descend toward the waterfront. In the far distance, modern glass towers rise from the opposite shore, contrasting sharply with the older layered district and emphasizing the city’s vast urban sprawl.

Style:
Fantasy hand-drawn watercolor illustration style. Traditional watercolor rendering with visible pigment splashes, fluid paint diffusion, and softly blended tonal transitions. Delicate hand-illustrated linework with expressive drawn detailing and organic sketch-like contours. Soft, gentle color palette emphasizing airy tones and subtle saturation rather than strong contrast. Painterly layered watercolor textures combined with illustrative fantasy art aesthetics. Decorative, richly illustrated environments with numerous small background details integrated into the composition. Elegant full illustration treatment prioritizing handcrafted visual charm, artistic softness, and classic storybook-inspired fantasy rendering.

场景：
一座密集的山坡城市向下延伸，直至宽阔的河流港口，港口内停满了货船、渡轮和水上市场。无数紧密堆叠的建筑爬满山坡，屋顶上挤满了卫星天线、水箱和晾晒的衣物。高架人行道在建筑之间穿梭，狭窄的小巷则通向水边。远处，现代玻璃塔楼从对岸拔地而起，与古老的分层街区形成鲜明对比，凸显了这座城市广阔的城市蔓延。

风格：
奇幻手绘水彩插画风格。传统水彩渲染，带有可见的颜料飞溅、流畅的颜料扩散和柔和混合的色调过渡。精致的手绘线条，带有富有表现力的细节描绘和有机素描般的轮廓。柔和、温和的调色板，强调轻盈的色调和微妙的饱和度，而非强烈的对比。画意盎然的分层水彩纹理与插画奇幻艺术美学相结合。装饰性强、细节丰富的环境，构图中融入了许多小背景细节。优雅的完整插画处理，优先考虑手工制作的视觉魅力、艺术柔和感和经典故事书风格的奇幻渲染。
